tool_schemas.name: brave_image_search
tool_schemas.description: Runs an image search for the provided query, authenticates the caller by api_key, records the request and client_metadata for audit, calls Brave upstream, persists the normalized image results, increments usage, and returns up to count results (default server behavior; maximum 20); this endpoint does not support pagination. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key has no remaining allowance, and VALIDATION_ERROR when q is empty or count is not an integer in the allowed range (1–20). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Brave fails to fulfill the request or returns an unexpected response.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

count.description: Requested number of results to return (max 20).

client_metadata.description: Optional caller-provided metadata to store with the search request for auditing/debugging.

Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key has no remaining allowance, and VALIDATION_ERROR when q is empty or count is not an integer in the allowed range (1–20). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Brave fails to fulfill the request or returns an unexpected response.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

count.description: Requested number of results to return (max 20).

client_metadata.description: Optional caller-provided metadata to store with the search request for auditing/debugging.

tool_schemas.name: brave_local_search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a local places/business search for the provided query, authenticates the caller by api_key, records the request and client_metadata for audit, calls Brave upstream, persists the normalized local results, increments usage, and returns up to count results (maximum 20); if fallback_to_web is true, the service performs a web search when local search fails or returns insufficient results, and returns the fallback results instead (no pagination). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key has no remaining allowance, and VALIDATION_ERROR when q is empty or count is not an integer in the allowed range (1–20). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when neither local search nor (if enabled) the web fallback can be fulfilled successfully by Brave.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

q.description: Search query text (often includes 'near me' or a place name).

count.description: Requested number of results to return (max 20).

client_metadata.description: Optional caller-provided metadata to store with the search request for auditing/debugging.

fallback_to_web.description: Whether to automatically fall back to a web search if local search has insufficient results or fails.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided api_key, including api_keys fields, allowed_tools, current lifecycle status, and current-day quota consumption across all tools. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is suspended/revoked.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search_requests for the authenticated api_key with optional filtering by status, tool_name, time range, and text query. Returns a paginated page of search_requests ordered by created_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that executed the request.

q_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to query_text.

created_after.description: Filter to requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Filter to requests created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search_requests row by id for the authenticated api_key, including its stored request fields and execution outcome. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, and NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

search_request_id.description: Primary key of the search_requests row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized search_results for a given search_request_id owned by the authenticated api_key, optionally filtered by result_type and ordered by rank ascending. Returns a paginated page of search_results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, and NOT_FOUND when the request does not exist or is not owned by the caller.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

search_request_id.description: Primary key of the parent search_requests row.

result_type.description: Filter results to a single result type.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: update_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a search_requests row owned by the authenticated api_key, primarily to drive lifecycle transitions (received→running/cancelled, running→succeeded/failed/cancelled) and to attach completion/error metadata. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled, NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller, and CONFLICT when attempting an invalid transition (including any transition out of succeeded/failed/cancelled).

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

search_request_id.description: Primary key of the search_requests row to update.

status.description: New status for the request; must follow the allowed lifecycle transitions.

upstream_provider.description: Upstream provider used to satisfy the request (e.g., 'brave').

fallback_used.description: Whether a fallback strategy was used (e.g., local search falling back to web).

tool_schemas.name: list_usage_counters
tool_schemas.description: Lists per-day usage_counters for the authenticated api_key with optional filtering by usage_date and tool_name. Returns a paginated page of counters that can be used to audit enforcement and remaining quota. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid/disabled.

api_key.description: Caller API key used for authentication and usage enforcement.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.
